About.title: 👨‍💻 About me
About.sobre: Frontend Software Engineer with experience building complex web applications across marketplace platforms, payment gateway flows, and financial solutions. I currently work at Wite Group, contributing directly to the development and evolution of a fintech platform. I also bring a full-stack background, a degree in Systems Analysis and Development, and a strong focus on code quality, scalability, performance, and user experience. I'm driven by continuous learning, collaboration, and delivering solutions with real impact.

Project1.title: My Portfolio
Project1.description: This is my personal website, where I present selected projects, experience, and the way I like to build products. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, and API integrations.

Project2.title: Restaurant Management
Project2.description: A restaurant management and service system focused on operations, order flow, and user experience. Built with React, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and MySQL.

Project3.title: FoodBoxd
Project3.description: FoodBoxd is a menu and review management system for cafeterias, developed in React Native with Firebase integration. It allows managers to create and edit daily/weekly menus, monitor user feedback, and view performance charts. Users can check menus, rate meals, and view nutritional info.

Project4.title: Blog Viewreo
Project4.description: I built a full-stack blog using Next.js, MongoDB, NextAuth, and Prisma. Users can securely authenticate, create and view posts, and interact with content. The solution features authentication with NextAuth, data management with MongoDB and Prisma, and a responsive UI built with React. Tech stack: Next.js, React, MongoDB, NextAuth, Prisma.

Project5.title: Planno Landing Page
Project5.description: 💼 I built this landing page with Vite + React, focusing on performance, responsiveness, and a clear user experience. It presents Planno, a personal finance management solution, in a modern and engaging way. 🚀

Project6.title: 🌸 Takusan - Discover Animes
Project6.description: 🎌 Takusan is a web app that lets you explore popular anime, view full details such as trailers, characters, and genres, and navigate a modern, animated UI. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GraphQL, and Framer Motion, this project focuses on user experience and performance.
